Details: Field[data] is an immutable field that transforms in one irrep of a finite group: it stores its ID, display name, irrep ID, dimension, the accepted matrices of that irrep (its transformation law), the basis identity and the frozen RepresentationContext it was created in.

Its components are inert FieldComponent atoms; the name is a display label and never becomes a Wolfram variable. Later reordering or basis changes of the group do not rewrite a field: it keeps its frozen context.
Create fields with CreateField; a Field whose data was edited by hand is rejected by every operation.
Field.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; Head[l]]

Details: FieldComponent[fieldID, i] is the inert i-th component of the Field with ID fieldID: an ordinary commuting scalar variable in polynomials.
Distinct fields have distinct components even when they transform in the same irrep; repeating one field in a contraction repeats the same components.
N leaves components unchanged (the index stays an integer), so numerical coefficients can be introduced with N without corrupting the variables.
FieldComponent.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; {Head[First[FieldComponents[l]]], N[First[FieldComponents[l]]] === First[FieldComponents[l]]}]

Details: CreateField[g, id, name] creates a field in the irrep id of the Group or RepresentationContext g, with a fresh ID and inert components FieldComponent[ID, 1], ..., FieldComponent[ID, d].
The irrep's accepted matrices must already exist in g; the field records them and the context, which is frozen at this point.
Two calls with the same irrep give independent fields; names must be nonempty strings and are unique within a model.
CreateField.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; {Length[FieldComponents[l]], FieldComponents[l] =!= FieldComponents[r]}]

Details: FieldComponents[f] lists the inert components of the Field f in the order of its representation matrices.
Join the lists of several fields to describe direct-sum content (for example a doublet and a singlet) in a chosen order.
FieldComponents.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; Length[FieldComponents[l]]]

Details: FieldVector[f] is the RepVector of the Field f: one record whose components are the field's inert components, in the field's irrep and basis.
Use it with TensorProductVectors for vector-valued (not only scalar) products of fields.
FieldVector.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; Head[FieldVector[l]]]

Details: Model[data] is an immutable finite-group model: its frozen context, ordered field records, a degree-one target irrep, the list of coupled terms, ordered parameter records, arithmetic settings and validation status.
Every operation returns a new Model; the input is never changed. A model built before a group's basis change keeps its frozen context and stays valid.
Stored statuses are not trusted: ValidateModel recomputes covariance, and records edited by hand are rejected.
Model.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; Head[m]]

Details: CreateModel[g, {f1, f2, ...}] creates an empty model (expression 0, no parameters) of the listed fields over the Group or RepresentationContext g.

Every field must belong to the same frozen context (same group, generators and bases); field IDs and names must be unique. An empty field list is allowed. With a Group, a model of fields whose context differs from the group's current one only by its state generation (a native GAP CG route ran a worker query) uses the fields' context; a changed basis or modular assignment, or fields of another group, fails with ContextMismatch.

Options: Name (default "Model"), TargetIrrep (Automatic: the trivial irrep), Arithmetic ("Exact" or "Numerical"), WorkingPrecision and Tolerance. When a field's or the target's accepted matrices are numerical (a Stage 2 numerical-tier variant), the model is numerical whatever arithmetic was requested, and its WorkingPrecision never exceeds the digits those matrices carry; matrices with fewer than 16 digits fail with NumericalInput. A Tolerance below 10^-digits of the effective precision fails with InvalidOption, and over numerical-tier matrices it must be at least the automatic tolerance 10^-Floor[digits/2] (numerical certificates never claim more accuracy than the data carry).
CreateModel.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; ModelExpression[m]]

Details: ContractionSet[data] holds every contraction path of a list of model fields into the model's target irrep: for each path its channel ID, CG channel IDs, scalar polynomial and zero status, in stable path order.

Zero paths and linearly dependent paths remain inspectable. After IndependentContractions it also carries Rank, the basis channels and Relations; set["Channels"], set["RawChannels"] and set["Relations"] read the data.
ContractionSet.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; Head[Contractions[m, {l, r}]]]

Details: Contractions[m, {f1, f2, ...}] gives every CG contraction of the listed fields of the model m into the model's target irrep, as a ContractionSet.

Factors are Field values or field IDs of the model, in order, repetitions allowed. Products run left-associatively through TensorProductVectors in the model's frozen context; no multiplicity copy is dropped and zero channels are kept.
CG options (Method, Normalization, ...) are passed on; accepted CG data may be cached by Stage 4 even if a later step fails. {} gives the unit only for the trivial target.

The precision of a numerical set is bounded by the representation matrices of its factors, its target and every irrep that can occur as an intermediate of the left-associated product; tolerances follow the CreateModel rule.
Contractions.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; Length[Contractions[m, {l, r}]["Channels"]]]

Details: IndependentContractions[set] chooses a linearly independent basis among the channel polynomials of set (over the scalar constants of the CG data, in path order) and records Relations: each original channel ID mapped to its coefficients in the basis channel IDs.

Field components are independent commuting variables, so a repeated field gives symmetric polynomials and fewer independent terms. Exact data give an exact rank; numerical data a numerical rank that fails when ambiguous at the declared tolerance.
The result's Channels are the basis; RawChannels keep every original path.
IndependentContractions.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; q = CreateModel[g, {l}]; raw = Contractions[q, {l, l, l, l}]; {Length[raw["Channels"]], IndependentContractions[raw]["Rank"]}]

Details: SelectContractions[set, ids] returns a new ContractionSet with exactly the listed known channel IDs, in the given order; the original set is unchanged.
IDs must be known and listed once; zero channels can be selected and remain inspectable.
SelectContractions.Example: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; q = CreateModel[g, {l}]; raw = Contractions[q, {l, l, l, l}]; With[{ids = Lookup[raw["Channels"], "ChannelID"]}, Lookup[SelectContractions[raw, Reverse[ids]]["Channels"], "ChannelID"] === Reverse[ids]]]
SelectContractions.ErrorExample: Module[{t, m2, q, raw, x, mass, g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], d, sign, l, r, m}, d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; sign = First[DeleteCases[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 1 &], g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]]]; l = CreateField[g, d, "L"]; r = CreateField[g, d, "R"]; m = CreateModel[g, {l, r}]; q = CreateModel[g, {l}]; raw = Contractions[q, {l, l, l, l}]; FailureQ[SelectContractions[raw, {"unknown"}]]]
